Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0054 1. Remark 2.17\group neckpinch

For a reflection-symmetric dumbbell with one neck and two bumps, the neckpinch can occur only on the totally geodesic hypersurface at the neck, provided the diameter stays bounded as the singular time is approached.
